description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the proportional composition of two categories, labeled "Ours" and "Standard," across three distinct components. The vertical axis serves as the category axis, displaying "Ours" at the top and "Standard" at the bottom, without an explicit axis label. The horizontal axis represents the value scale, which corresponds to percentages totaling 100% for each stacked bar; however, it lacks an explicit label, tick marks, and numeric intervals. Each horizontal bar is divided into three stacked segments, arranged from left to right according to a legend located at the bottom of the chart: "Context" in blue, "Generated Response" in orange, and "Other" in green. For the "Ours" category, the segments consist of Context at 60.6%, Generated Response at 31.7%, and Other at 7.7%. For the "Standard" category, the segments are Context at 23.6%, Generated Response at 51.1%, and Other at 25.3%. Every segment is visually emphasized with a direct text annotation of its exact percentage value centered within the block, using white text for the blue "Context" segments and black text for the orange and green segments. The categories on the vertical axis do not follow a strict alphabetical order, and the stacked components consistently follow the same left-to-right sequence for both main categories.
